summary: Full backend + frontend e2e testing of Bengali Islamic Institute. All 18 pytest backend tests passed and all 11 Playwright frontend flows passed. No critical issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~770 lines and mixes models + routes + seed logic; could be split into routers/models/services modules for maintainability.
JWT cookie is set with samesite='none' + secure=true (correct for cross-origin), but frontend also stores token in localStorage as Bearer fallback — works fine.
No brute-force lockout / rate limiting on /api/auth/login (playbook recommends 5-fail lockout). Currently any number of attempts allowed.
Payment is intentionally MOCKED (1.2s simulated bKash/Nagad) — labelled as DEMO in UI; flagged for future real integration.
Settings PUT accepts raw dict (no Pydantic validation) — fine for admin-only but could be tightened.
Posts/videos/live/notification delete endpoints don't return 404 when id missing (silent ok). Minor.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@bii.edu / Admin@123 ; Student created at runtime via /api/auth/register
seed_data_creation: Tests created ephemeral admin-side resources (course/video/post/live/notification) and cleaned them up after assertions. Registered fresh student accounts (email teststudent+<uuid>@bii.edu).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_bii_api.py cover health, public seeded endpoints, full auth lifecycle (register, login, me, change-password, profile update), admin CRUD for courses/videos/posts/live/notifications, 403 role enforcement, enrollment flow (free + already_enrolled), contact (unauth), complaint (auth). Frontend Playwright covered home page (data-testid home-page, home-login-cta, menu-our-courses), register (reg-name/email/password, register-submit-btn → home-student-id banner showed 20260002), free course enroll (enroll-btn → /payment/success), paid course (enroll-btn label 'পেমেন্টে এগিয়ে যান' → pay-now-btn → /payment/success), lang-toggle-btn switches Bengali→English ('আমাদের কোর্সসমূহ'→'Our Courses'), sidebar (open-sidebar-btn, sb-logout-btn, sb-admin), protected route /my-courses redirects to /login when logged out, admin login shows sb-admin and /admin dashboard shows stats (Courses 3, Users 3, Notifications 1). Payment is MOCKED per request.
